## Description {#details}

<p>This file provides various utilities for inspecting and working with the control flow graph in LLVM IR.</p>


<p>This includes generic facilities for iterating successors and predecessors of basic blocks, the successors of specific terminator instructions, etc. It also defines specializations of GraphTraits that allow Function and BasicBlock graphs to be treated as proper graphs for generic algorithms.</p>
